procedure: EA-NEGONT-02 v0.9 §3.4 D/R/O (working; not frozen). Admission by reading: a candidate is admitted when its sentence or paragraph makes a claim bearing on the originality claim at SE 34, 184b1–8 with its setting 183b34–184a8: what it says, its words, its force, its domain, its place at the end of the SE and the Topics, its reception. Naming the passage or using the word 'originality' is not enough. Machine compositions quoted in deposits are reception evidence and not archive claims (the Capture Registry entries are context in the row's notes). Volume is never a ground of removal; instances of one work are grouped as a lineage and kept.

verdicts.reason: The defining paper (read whole: the main paper §§1–10, the appendix A1–A7 and B1–B5, the checklist). D: the claim stated as the note's thesis and as exactly Aristotle's (A1 §1, §6: 'This note argues that Sophistical Refutations 184b1–2 says that there was nothing of syllogizing prior to Aristotle'; the 'we' is the chapter's); the setting 183a37–184b8 read line by line; the reception measured: every review inserts a qualifier between παντελῶς and οὐδέν, the invariant the deletion of οὐ; the received reading of 'every reference work' stated. R: the Capture Registry's instrument (PER) turned on a canonical text. O: provenance erasure, disciplinary model collapse, the world soul as degraded commodity applied to the claim's reception. The NOTHING-SE34 notes (the flat note A1 v1.0, REFLEX A2, CLAUSE A3, DIVISION A4, v1.4 A5, v2.0 A6, APPARATUS A7) are inside this deposit and are read as its appendix.

The second defining paper (read whole: §§1–9, notes, Texts, Appendices P, L, A). D: the denial total; the qualifier lives in the gloss, not the translations; the axis provenance; the count at 184b1–2 its own claim; Socrates dissolved as predecessor-source, placed inside the explanation of the second task; the ending as exercise and as enactment; nine prohibitions with their reach; the witness apparatus (Byzantine paraphrast, Arabic, Albert, Giles, Poste, Pickard-Cambridge, Forster) with the degree-reading unattested before the modern period. R: the machine sample (#1574) as the present tense of the reception. O: the prohibitions as a device against the supplied qualification.

Many and One as submitted (read at §1, §2.1–2.4, §9.1–9.6, notes 1, 5, 11, 22): the claim named as the originality claim closing the Topics–SE inquiry; its usual reading (true of the syllogistic, modest about the rest) stated at full strength and not refuted; the paragraph's sense of 'beforehand' as reception; the claim read in its verb; the partial-development reading refused by the sentence; the single-maker hypothesis tied to the claim (§9.4) with its bound (§9.6).

Many and One, the reading copy (read at the apparatus 'The SE epilogue and its scope' [S1]–[X.11], §I ¶¶1–17, §4 ¶¶16–19, §4a–4b, and the Greek register G2–G3): the received account of Aristotle's originality 'built on not asking' the question; the conventional reading at full strength (a systematic art); Hitchcock's restriction to the Topics and SE; the developmental reading; the claim's terms read as legitimacy terms and the pardon and thanks as a request to adjudicate a claim of first finding; the configurational reading as hypothesis.

The authorship notebook (read at S1 ¶¶499–501, Round 18 ¶¶577–578, ¶1517): two hypotheses on why the claim is literal (nothing before because not yet written; because the operation's range had not been seen). Instances of the maker-count lineage, earliest dated statements of it (2026-08-31).

The measurement register (read at §0A.1–0A.6): the register's self-correction ('Two earlier versions of M40 called the narrow reading "an interpretive repair" … Both are WRONG'), 'practice versus art' read as Aristotle's own frame, and the open philological question at περὶ τοῦ συλλογίζεσθαι. Carried as a lineage of its own: the archive's earlier reading, which #1603 §4 contests ('The defender's contrast — discipline versus untheorized practice — is not on the page').
Reached by the hop (from #1569, #1570). M40's pre-registration: 'Aristotle claims the development of syllogizing and negates prior partial development (SE 183b)'. One claim, the maker-count lineage.
Beautiful and New n. 9: the companion paper's argument stated in one clause (the denial total, Socrates inside the inquiry's account). An instance of the Socrates-inside lineage.

Reached by the hop (from #1594, #1605, #1684). The First Draft notebook, the version of 2026-09-06 (#1589 is the same text; #1594 and #1605 the later versions): Aristotle files Socratic operations inside the ἀρχή of his art; the epilogue's boast is about now (the δύναμις made handable); the qualification reflex as conflation of two survivals (hypothesis).

The First Draft notebook, later version (#1605 the same text at these paragraphs): the second reader's audit adopted for #1603 (the denial excludes even a partial antecedent; no 'systematic' occurs), and the ἄλλο correction at 184b1 (first-person, πρότερον, λέγειν, no πρὸ ἡμῶν). The notebook's #1574 summary block and the prohibitions paragraph restate #1574 and #1603 and add nothing (S4: instances, kept in the graph).

Reached by the hop (from #1574, #1603, #1684). The concept-keyed table names the entity itself: 'Aristotle's originality claim | nothing before, total, first person | C | #1574 | qualified | correct'; the SE row ('"systematic" is supplied by reception'); and the δ_W sentence at SE 34. The v1 row of this entity (rows.json) is seated from this notebook.
The prediction index, §7.3: the page for #1574 and #1603 ('9 claims'), summarizing the two papers. An index instance; one claim ledgered as the archive's own compression of its reading.

Socrates as Orthonym, read at its defining sections (Abstract, §0, §I, §I.A, §III, §IV, §V, §V.A) as the brief asks: it names neither the Sophistical Refutations nor the claim, and makes no claim on what 184b1–8 says, its force, domain, place or reception. observations: The archive's account of the claim is concentrated in two defining papers, #1574 and #1603, with #1576 and #1575 naming it as the originality claim at the close of the Topics–SE inquiry and stating the received reading at full strength. Everything else admitted restates, indexes or audits those (the First Draft notebook, #1611, #1684, #1579) or ties the maker-count hypothesis to the claim (#1569, #1571, #1576 §9.4).

The archive is not uniform on practice and art: #1570 §0A.2 holds that '"Practice versus art" is not a modern rescue. It is Aristotle's own frame, in this passage', and #1575 §I ¶3 states the conventional reading as 'about a systematic art'; #1603 §4 answers that the shoemaker 'does not oppose the organized to the raw; it opposes the art to its products'. Carried as its own lineage, marked contested within the pool.

The archive's alias strings for the claim are few and Greek-heavy: the string pass finds the claim in 10 deposits; the hop adds 3. The English phrases the field uses ('first logician', 'invented logic') return nothing in the archive.
